= Title Lookalikes
:product-name: Driftbeam

This file pins negative parsing cases: AsciiDoc lines that resemble document structure but are not.
A structure-aware chunker must not treat any of the lines below as titles or list items.

The listing block that follows contains lines that start with an equals sign; they are program output, not document or section titles.

[source,text]
----
= run summary =
== phase one complete ==
=== nested marker in a banner ===
elapsed: 4.2s
records: 18422
----

Every equals-prefixed line above sits inside a delimited listing block, so none of them opens a new section.
A parser that promotes them to headings has ignored the listing delimiters.

*Important:* the line above starts with an asterisk, but it is a bold phrase, not an unordered list item, because the asterisk closes on the same word.
Bold-leading lines are common in migration notes and warning paragraphs.

* this line, by contrast, is a real list item
* and so is this one

The two starred lines directly above are a genuine unordered list, which makes the distinction observable: bold-lead paragraph before, real list after.

[listing]
----
= another banner that begins with equals
still inside a listing block
----

The final listing repeats the equals-prefixed case using the listing style attribute rather than a source block.
